ns2:course.label: Systematics of Plants
ns2:course.description: Introduces the principles and methods of the identification, naming, classification, systematics, and evolution of flowering plants; includes a survey of selected flowering plant families with information on their interrelationships. Prerequisite: One of the following: IB 100, IB 103, IB 150, or consent of instructor.
